task_meta.title: Fix an order-export importer that chokes on (and mis-totals) the real export file

claim_text:
`python -m importer exports/orders_2024-09.csv` now works. Its total matches the export's own summary line, and August's output is unchanged.

**September per-customer totals** (40 orders counted, 5 cancelled):

| Customer | Total |
|---|---:|
| Atelier Moreau | 5,069.40 |
| Bake
digest: Read 4 files (3 before its first edit), made 10 edits, ran tests 3 times; re-ran them after its last edit.
